mcqs.question: What was the 2026 theme of World Milk Day, observed on 1 June?
options: Milk Has Many Faces: Most of Them Are Women
Role of parents in child development
Inspired by Nature. For Climate. For Our Future
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 theme of World Milk Day was “Milk Has Many Faces: Most of Them Are Women,” highlighting women in the dairy value chain. “Role of parents in child development” was associated with the Global Day of Parents.

mcqs.question: The Global Day of Parents, observed on 1 June, had which theme in 2026?
options: Role of parents in child development
Proudly In My Skin: Celebrating All Skin Tones
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 theme of the Global Day of Parents was “Role of parents in child development.” “Protect Play, Protect Childhood” was the theme of the International Day of Play.

mcqs.question:
Match the observances in List-I with their dates in List-II.

List-I
(a) Telangana Formation Day
(b) World Bicycle Day
(c) International Day of Innocent Children Victims of Aggression
(d) World Environment Day

List-II
(i) 5 June
(ii) 3 June
(iii) 2 June
(iv) 4 June
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-ii, c-iv and d-i: Telangana Formation Day is on 2 June, World Bicycle Day on 3 June, the International Day of Innocent Children Victims of Aggression on 4 June, and World Environment Day on 5 June. The other codes interchange these adjacent June dates.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the International Day against IUU Fishing is incorrect?
options: It has no official theme in 2026.
Its date is associated with the entry into force of the FAO Port State Measures Agreement.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that it was first observed in 2019; the correct year was 2018. The day is observed on 5 June, has no official 2026 theme, and is linked to the FAO Port State Measures Agreement entering into force.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about June 2026 observances:
1. Russian Language Day is associated with the birthday of poet Alexander Pushkin and has been observed since 2010.
2. The 2026 theme of World Food Safety Day is “From burden to solutions – safe food everywhere”.
3. The International Day for Dialogue among Civilizations has been observed since 2023.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Russian Language Day is linked with Alexander Pushkin’s birthday and dates from 2010, while World Food Safety Day carries the stated theme. Statement 3 is incorrect because the International Day for Dialogue among Civilizations has been observed since 2024.

mcqs.question: What was the 2026 theme of the International Day of Play?
options: Fair play for children, decent work for adults
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 theme of the International Day of Play was “Protect Play, Protect Childhood.” “Fair play for children, decent work for adults” was associated with the World Day Against Child Labour.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The 2026 theme of the World Day Against Child Labour was “Red card to child labour: Fair play for children, decent work for adults”.
Statement B: International Albinism Awareness Day had the 2026 theme “Proudly In My Skin: Celebrating All Skin Tones”.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The World Day Against Child Labour carried the stated “Red card” theme, while International Albinism Awareness Day used “Proudly In My Skin: Celebrating All Skin Tones”.

mcqs.question: Which organisation is associated with World Blood Donor Day, whose 2026 theme was “One Drop of Humanity. Give Blood. Save Lives.”?
mcqs.explanation: World Blood Donor Day is associated with WHO, and its 2026 theme was “One Drop of Humanity. Give Blood. Save Lives.” ILO is associated with the World Day Against Child Labour.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The 2026 theme of World Elder Abuse Awareness Day was “Beyond Awareness: Making Elder Abuse Prevention Work”.
Reason (R): World Elder Abuse Awareness Day has been observed since 2007.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true because that was the 2026 theme of World Elder Abuse Awareness Day. Reason R is false: the day has been observed since 2006, not 2007.

mcqs.question: Which portal was launched in connection with Global Wind Day in June 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The WT-MARUT portal was launched in connection with Global Wind Day. The FAO Port State Measures Agreement is associated with the International Day against IUU Fishing.

mcqs.question:
Match the observances in List-I with their associated organisation or organisations in List-II.

List-I
(a) International Day of Family Remittances
(b) World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought
(c) Sustainable Gastronomy Day
(d) International Day for Countering Hate Speech

List-II
(i) UN / UNESCO
(ii) IFAD
(iii) UNCCD
(iv) UN / FAO / UNESCO
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii, c-iv and d-i: IFAD is associated with Family Remittances, UNCCD with Desertification and Drought, UN/FAO/UNESCO with Sustainable Gastronomy, and UN/UNESCO with Countering Hate Speech. The other codes interchange the organisations.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about observances on 19 and 20 June:
1. The 2026 theme of World Sickle Cell Day was “Closing the Survival Gap: Equity in Sickle Cell Care”.
2. The 2026 theme of the International Day for Elimination of Sexual Violence in Conflict referred to conflict-related sexual violence against children.
3. The theme of World Refugee Day was “Until Everyone Is Safe and Secure”.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The World Refugee Day theme was “Until Everyone Is Safe”, so statement 3 incorrectly adds the words “and Secure”.

mcqs.question: What was the 2026 theme of World Hydrography Day, associated with the IHO?
options: Transforming How Ocean Data Is Shared
Carrying world trade. Carrying the risks.
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 theme of World Hydrography Day was “Transforming How Ocean Data Is Shared”, and the associated body was IHO. “Reimagine” was the theme of World Oceans Day.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about World Rainforest Day is incorrect?
options: Its 2026 theme was “The Forest Within You”.
It was established by the Rainforest Partnership.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that it was established by the Rainforest Partnership; the fact identifies Rainforest Partnership as the associated body, not as the establishing body. The day is observed on 22 June, has the stated theme, and dates from 2017.

mcqs.question: Who founded World Camel Day?
mcqs.explanation: World Camel Day was founded by Dr Abdul Raziq Kakar. Alexander Pushkin is associated with Russian Language Day, while P.C. Mahalanobis is associated with National Statistics Day.

mcqs.question: Which organisation is associated with Olympic Day, whose 2026 theme was “You Can Do This! Let's Move”?
mcqs.explanation: Olympic Day is associated with the IOC and had the theme “You Can Do This! Let's Move” in 2026. IMO is associated with the Day of the Seafarer.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about observances in June 2026 are correct?
1. UN Public Service Day has been observed since 2003.
2. International Widows' Day has been observed since 2011.
3. The Day of the Seafarer has been observed since 2012.
4. The International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking has been observed since 1990.
mcqs.explanation: Only statements 1 and 2 are correct: UN Public Service Day dates from 2003 and International Widows' Day from 2011. The Day of the Seafarer dates from 2011, while the International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking dates from 1989.

mcqs.question:
Match the observances in List-I with their associated organisation or organisations in List-II.

List-I
(a) International Day in Support of Victims of Torture
(b) MSME Day
(c) International Asteroid Day
(d) International Day of Parliamentarism

List-II
(i) UN / IPU
(ii) UN / OHCHR
(iii) UNOOSA / Asteroid Day Foundation
(iv) UN / UNIDO / ITC
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iv, c-iii and d-i: Victims of Torture is associated with UN/OHCHR, MSME Day with UN/UNIDO/ITC, International Asteroid Day with UNOOSA/Asteroid Day Foundation, and Parliamentarism with UN/IPU. The other options exchange these associated bodies.
